text:
What you need to know

We previously announced how industrial action would impact HMRC employer services from 23 December 2024.

Delays caused by this have created a significant backlog in cases being processed by HMRC PT Operations Employer Services Team.

HMRC will continue to deliver the:

Employer helpline

Construction Industry Scheme (CIS) helpline

The phone lines and webchat will be open 8am to 6pm as usual but you may experience longer wait times.

What you need to do

If your case is affected by the industrial action, use our online tool to check when you can expect a reply from HMRC.

Do not send details of affected cases to our mailbox at insolcustservices@hmrc.gov.uk during the industrial action, as our team will not be able to deal with them.

We apologise for any inconvenience this may cause.

We aim to meet our service standards as soon as possible when the industrial action ends.

Further questions

If you have any questions about this Insolvency Bulletin, direct them to R3 or your representative group who will take them forward with HMRC.
